summary: Someone else's life can become unusually magnetic when it seems to contain the permission you have not given yourself.
body: Someone else's life can become unusually magnetic when it seems to contain the permission you have not given yourself. When Neptune opposes Lilith, a crush, friend, public figure, relationship, or imagined future can start carrying a desire that is difficult to admit directly. You may envy their freedom, idealize their choices, or resent how easily they appear to claim something you keep denying yourself. The feeling is information, not proof that their life is the answer. Name the exact thing you want more of, less of, or permission to change. It becomes easier to act on once it stops belonging to somebody else.
